Converted from the original R workflow script so the dissertation repository uses R Markdown workflow artefacts.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(lubridate)
  library(sandwich)
  library(lmtest)
})

base_dir <- "/Users/lu_nanxi/CASA/Dissertation_Data"
modelling_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Vivacity_full_day_cutoff_20260526", "modelling_ready")
table_dir <- file.path(modelling_dir, "tables")
diag_dir <- file.path(modelling_dir, "causal_diagnostics")
plot_dir <- file.path(diag_dir, "plots")
dir.create(diag_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_weekly <- file.path(table_dir, "vivacity_main_causal_weekly_countline.csv")

weekly <- readr::read_csv(
  input_weekly,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    analysis_scheme_id = readr::col_character(),
    scheme_id = readr::col_character(),
    countline_id = readr::col_character()
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    week_start = as_date(week_start),
    intervention_date = as_date(intervention_date),
    first_reliable_date = as_date(first_reliable_date),
    analysis_scheme_id = as.character(analysis_scheme_id),
    countline_id_chr = as.character(countline_id),
    countline_id = as.factor(countline_id),
    treated = dataset_role == "treated",
    post = week_start >= intervention_date,
    rel_week = floor(as.numeric(week_start - intervention_date) / 7),
    weeks_since_start = as.numeric(week_start - min(week_start, na.rm = TRUE)) / 7,
    week_of_year = isoweek(week_start),
    season_sin = sin(2 * pi * week_of_year / 52.1775),
    season_cos = cos(2 * pi * week_of_year / 52.1775),
    calendar_month = factor(format(week_start, "%Y-%m"))
  )

outcomes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~outcome, ~label,
  "active_per_observed_day", "Active travel",
  "pedestrian_per_observed_day", "Pedestrian",
  "cyclist_per_observed_day", "Cyclist"
)

make_dat <- function(scheme, outcome) {
  weekly |>
    filter(analysis_scheme_id == scheme) |>
    mutate(
      y_raw = .data[[outcome]],
      log_outcome = log1p(pmax(y_raw, 0)),
      model_weight = pmax(observed_days, 1)
    ) |>
    filter(is.finite(log_outcome), !is.na(intervention_date))
}

cluster_coeftest <- function(model, cluster) {
  vcov_cluster <- sandwich::vcovCL(model, cluster = cluster, type = "HC1")
  lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = vcov_cluster)
}

extract_term <- function(ct, term_name) {
  if (!term_name %in% rownames(ct)) {
    return(tibble(
      term = term_name,
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std_error_cluster = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  tibble(
    term = term_name,
    estimate = unname(ct[term_name, 1]),
    std_error_cluster = unname(ct[term_name, 2]),
    statistic = unname(ct[term_name, 3]),
    p_value = unname(ct[term_name, 4])
  )
}

fit_pretrend <- function(scheme, outcome, label) {
  dat <- make_dat(scheme, outcome) |>
    filter(week_start < intervention_date)

  pre_summary <- dat |>
    summarise(
      n_rows = n(),
      n_countlines = n_distinct(countline_id),
      n_treated_countlines = n_distinct(countline_id[treated]),
      n_control_countlines = n_distinct(countline_id[!treated]),
      first_pre_week = min(week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
      last_pre_week = max(week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
      pre_weeks_span = as.numeric(max(week_start, na.rm = TRUE) - min(week_start, na.rm = TRUE)) / 7
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 20 || n_distinct(dat$treated) < 2 || pre_summary$pre_weeks_span < 8) {
    return(pre_summary |>
      mutate(
        scheme_id = scheme,
        outcome = outcome,
        outcome_label = label,
        term = "treatedTRUE:rel_week",
        estimate = NA_real_,
        std_error_cluster = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        percent_change_per_week = NA_real_,
        diagnostic = "insufficient_pre_period"
      ) |>
      select(scheme_id, outcome, outcome_label, everything()))
  }

  model <- lm(
    log_outcome ~ rel_week * treated + season_sin + season_cos + countline_id,
    data = dat,
    weights = model_weight
  )
  ct <- cluster_coeftest(model, dat$countline_id)
  term_row <- extract_term(ct, "rel_week:treatedTRUE")
  term_estimate <- term_row[["estimate"]]
  term_se <- term_row[["std_error_cluster"]]
  term_statistic <- term_row[["statistic"]]
  term_p_value <- term_row[["p_value"]]

  pre_summary |>
    mutate(
      scheme_id = scheme,
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_label = label,
      term = "rel_week:treatedTRUE",
      estimate = term_estimate,
      std_error_cluster = term_se,
      statistic = term_statistic,
      p_value = term_p_value,
      percent_change_per_week = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
      diagnostic = case_when(
        is.na(p_value) ~ "not_estimable",
        p_value < 0.05 ~ "pretrend_warning",
        TRUE ~ "no_statistical_pretrend_warning"
      )
    ) |>
    select(scheme_id, outcome, outcome_label, everything())
}

event_bin_levels <- c(
  "pre_52_to_25",
  "pre_24_to_13",
  "pre_12_to_5",
  "pre_4_to_1",
  "post_0_to_3",
  "post_4_to_11",
  "post_12_to_25",
  "post_26_to_51",
  "post_52_to_103",
  "post_104_plus"
)

event_bin_midpoints <- tibble::tribble(
  ~event_bin, ~rel_week_midpoint, ~period,
  "pre_52_to_25", -38.5, "pre",
  "pre_24_to_13", -18.5, "pre",
  "pre_12_to_5", -8.5, "pre",
  "pre_4_to_1", -2.5, "reference",
  "post_0_to_3", 1.5, "post",
  "post_4_to_11", 7.5, "post",
  "post_12_to_25", 18.5, "post",
  "post_26_to_51", 38.5, "post",
  "post_52_to_103", 77.5, "post",
  "post_104_plus", 120, "post"
)

add_event_bins <- function(dat) {
  dat |>
    mutate(
      event_bin = case_when(
        rel_week <= -25 & rel_week >= -52 ~ "pre_52_to_25",
        rel_week <= -13 & rel_week >= -24 ~ "pre_24_to_13",
        rel_week <= -5 & rel_week >= -12 ~ "pre_12_to_5",
        rel_week <= -1 & rel_week >= -4 ~ "pre_4_to_1",
        rel_week >= 0 & rel_week <= 3 ~ "post_0_to_3",
        rel_week >= 4 & rel_week <= 11 ~ "post_4_to_11",
        rel_week >= 12 & rel_week <= 25 ~ "post_12_to_25",
        rel_week >= 26 & rel_week <= 51 ~ "post_26_to_51",
        rel_week >= 52 & rel_week <= 103 ~ "post_52_to_103",
        rel_week >= 104 ~ "post_104_plus",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      event_bin = factor(event_bin, levels = event_bin_levels),
      event_bin = relevel(event_bin, ref = "pre_4_to_1")
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(event_bin))
}

fit_event_study <- function(scheme, outcome, label) {
  dat <- make_dat(scheme, outcome) |>
    add_event_bins()

  required_ref <- dat |>
    filter(event_bin == "pre_4_to_1") |>
    summarise(has_treated = any(treated), has_control = any(!treated))

  if (nrow(dat) < 40 || !required_ref$has_treated || !required_ref$has_control) {
    return(tibble(
      scheme_id = scheme,
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_label = label,
      event_bin = event_bin_levels,
      rel_week_midpoint = event_bin_midpoints$rel_week_midpoint,
      period = event_bin_midpoints$period,
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std_error_cluster = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      percent_change = NA_real_,
      conf_low_percent = NA_real_,
      conf_high_percent = NA_real_,
      n_rows = nrow(dat),
      n_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id),
      diagnostic = "event_study_not_estimable"
    ))
  }

  model <- lm(
    log_outcome ~ event_bin + event_bin:treated + countline_id,
    data = dat,
    weights = model_weight
  )
  ct <- cluster_coeftest(model, dat$countline_id)

  terms <- tibble(term = rownames(ct)) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "^event_bin.*:treatedTRUE$")) |>
    mutate(
      event_bin = str_remove(term, "^event_bin"),
      event_bin = str_remove(event_bin, ":treatedTRUE$")
    )

  coef_tbl <- tibble(
    term = rownames(ct),
    estimate = unname(ct[, 1]),
    std_error_cluster = unname(ct[, 2]),
    statistic = unname(ct[, 3]),
    p_value = unname(ct[, 4])
  )

  event_effects <- terms |>
    left_join(coef_tbl, by = "term") |>
    select(event_bin, estimate, std_error_cluster, statistic, p_value)

  reference <- tibble(
    event_bin = "pre_4_to_1",
    estimate = 0,
    std_error_cluster = NA_real_,
    statistic = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_
  )

  bind_rows(reference, event_effects) |>
    right_join(event_bin_midpoints, by = "event_bin") |>
    mutate(
      scheme_id = scheme,
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_label = label,
      percent_change = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
      conf_low_percent = 100 * (exp(estimate - 1.96 * std_error_cluster) - 1),
      conf_high_percent = 100 * (exp(estimate + 1.96 * std_error_cluster) - 1),
      n_rows = nrow(dat),
      n_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id),
      n_treated_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id[dat$treated]),
      n_control_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id[!dat$treated]),
      diagnostic = case_when(
        event_bin == "pre_4_to_1" ~ "reference_period",
        is.na(estimate) ~ "not_observed_or_not_estimable",
        period == "pre" & !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05 ~ "pre_event_warning",
        period == "post" & !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05 ~ "post_event_flagged",
        TRUE ~ "not_statistically_flagged"
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(rel_week_midpoint) |>
    select(
      scheme_id, outcome, outcome_label, event_bin, rel_week_midpoint, period,
      estimate, std_error_cluster, statistic, p_value, percent_change,
      conf_low_percent, conf_high_percent, n_rows, n_countlines,
      n_treated_countlines, n_control_countlines, diagnostic
    )
}

schemes <- sort(unique(weekly$analysis_scheme_id))

pretrend <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  scheme = schemes,
  outcome = outcomes$outcome
) |>
  left_join(outcomes, by = "outcome") |>
  pmap_dfr(\(scheme, outcome, label) fit_pretrend(scheme, outcome, label))

event_study <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  scheme = schemes,
  outcome = outcomes$outcome
) |>
  left_join(outcomes, by = "outcome") |>
  pmap_dfr(\(scheme, outcome, label) fit_event_study(scheme, outcome, label))

readr::write_csv(pretrend, file.path(diag_dir, "vivacity_pretrend_diagnostics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(event_study, file.path(diag_dir, "vivacity_event_study_coefficients.csv"))

diagnostic_summary <- pretrend |>
  group_by(scheme_id) |>
  summarise(
    pretrend_models = n(),
    pretrend_warnings = sum(diagnostic == "pretrend_warning", na.rm = TRUE),
    insufficient_pretrend_models = sum(diagnostic == "insufficient_pre_period", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    event_study |>
      group_by(scheme_id) |>
      summarise(
        pre_event_warnings = sum(diagnostic == "pre_event_warning", na.rm = TRUE),
        post_event_flags = sum(diagnostic == "post_event_flagged", na.rm = TRUE),
        event_bins_estimable = sum(!is.na(estimate), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "scheme_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    causal_readiness = case_when(
      pretrend_warnings > 0 | pre_event_warnings > 0 ~ "weak_pretrend_support",
      insufficient_pretrend_models > 0 ~ "limited_pre_period_support",
      TRUE ~ "passes_statistical_pretrend_screen"
    )
  )

readr::write_csv(diagnostic_summary, file.path(diag_dir, "vivacity_causal_diagnostic_summary.csv"))

plot_event_study <- function(outcome_name) {
  dat <- event_study |>
    filter(outcome == outcome_name, !is.na(percent_change)) |>
    mutate(
      event_bin = factor(event_bin, levels = event_bin_levels),
      period = factor(period, levels = c("pre", "reference", "post"))
    )

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = rel_week_midpoint, y = percent_change)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low_percent, ymax = conf_high_percent), width = 2.5, alpha = 0.65) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = diagnostic), shape = 21, size = 2.8, colour = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ scheme_id, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "reference_period" = "#757575",
        "not_statistically_flagged" = "#6baed6",
        "pre_event_warning" = "#fdae6b",
        "post_event_flagged" = "#de2d26",
        "not_observed_or_not_estimable" = "#bdbdbd"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(unique(dat$outcome_label), ": event-study treated-control differences"),
      subtitle = "Effects are relative to the 4 weeks before intervention; dashed line marks the intervention week",
      x = "Weeks relative to intervention",
      y = "Treated-control difference relative to pre-period (%)",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  out_file <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0("event_study_", outcome_name, ".png"))
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 180)
}

purrr::walk(outcomes$outcome, plot_event_study)

pretrend_lines <- pretrend |>
  mutate(
    line = sprintf(
      "- `%s` %s: pre-trend slope difference %+.3f%% per week, p = %s (%s)",
      scheme_id,
      outcome_label,
      percent_change_per_week,
      if_else(is.na(p_value), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", p_value)),
      diagnostic
    )
  ) |>
  pull(line)

summary_lines <- c(
  "# Vivacity Causal Diagnostics",
  "",
  "## Purpose",
  "",
  "These diagnostics test whether the current matched-control design is credible enough to support stronger causal interpretation.",
  "",
  "## Pre-Trend Test",
  "",

  "",
  "`log1p(outcome_per_observed_day) ~ relative_week * treated + seasonality + countline fixed effects`",
  "",
  "The key term is `relative_week:treatedTRUE`. If this is statistically flagged, treated and control countlines were already trending differently before intervention, weakening causal interpretation.",
  "",
  pretrend_lines,
  "",
  "## Event-Study Diagnostic",
  "",
  "The event-study model estimates treated-control differences in relative-week bins, using the four weeks before intervention as the reference period.",
  "",

  "",
  "## Outputs",

  "- `vivacity_pretrend_diagnostics.csv`",

  "",
  "## Caution",
  "",

)

writeLines(summary_lines, file.path(diag_dir, "README.md"))

print(diagnostic_summary)
```
